policy.rule: When integrating Animation Studio, inspect repository history/branches and preserve unique useful style capabilities from older versions. Do not treat latest main as the only style source.
policy.recommendation: Storyboard style recommendation uses scenario/TTS semantics, VTube learned history, active templates, and this full style registry. Never force fixed 5-second style changes.
policy.promotion: Historical styles are RESTORED_CANDIDATE until build/runtime/render QA; current verified templates retain their own status.
policy.textRule: Presentation/data styles use short labels, numbers, charts and concise phrases only; avoid text-heavy frames.

styles.rightsNote: Use only abstract painterly/narrative traits; avoid direct imitation of protected characters/scenes.

styles.rule: Mix styles by semantic/time blocks, not fixed interval.

storyboardSelectionRules: Analyze full script and TTS first.
Retrieve VTube/Animation learned history and successful style combinations before recommending.
Select duration boundaries from semantic changes, narration pauses, information density, emotion and visual purpose; fixed 5-second cuts are prohibited.
Use data/presentation styles selectively for numbers, charts, comparisons, educational summaries and document-like review moments.
Keep presentation/data frames low-text: one headline or short phrase, one key number/chart/table focus, optional short label.
Allow multiple style families in one video and preserve persona/asset continuity across style transitions.
Natural-language bot and whiteboard patch modify only requested ranges/scenes; approved segments stay locked by default.

styleLearningScope.rule: Consume existing approved assets via references. Route gaps to their existing owner chat; do not duplicate packs, workers, triggers or paid calls.

styleLearningCoverage.policy: A reference pointer is not a learned or production-approved style. Do not duplicate old Queens or T1 records. Reuse the related pattern, inspect the actual media and test applicability; the BBC chart reference is method-only, not a Docs/Sheets production claim. No automatic promotion.
styleLearningCoverage.next: Verify existing collection consumer and ACK before sending gap requests. Prioritize missing styles by user task demand, not numerical coverage alone.
